Messages.Author: Romu Sebastian J B
Messages.Body:
I had a question come up during a game last night.

Black Cat had a Flame thrower, and found herself in a tough fight.

I used the Flame thrower, and threw down a Blur... in essence giving her
three strikes at 2R aggravated...

Does all the damage get applied together... thereby burning her opponent
or would her opponent escape to topor after the initial strike?

Just wondering... we house ruled it that the opponent got burned. :)

Seb.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:







Each strike gets resolved before the next strike is chosen, so her opponent
would have escaped to torpor after the first hit.
